summary: Dragonfly Energy Holdings filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, with its subsidiary Battle Born and lenders amending a senior secured term loan. The Eighth Amendment waives the minimum liquidity covenant for the fiscal month ending September 30, 2026, defers part of a Series B preferred cash dividend, and adds a $450,000 PIK amendment fee to principal. Series B holders separately waived the full dividend, with 2% payable by October 1 and 6% by October 30. No special-situation transaction is disclosed.
